filings.description: On August 7, 2026, Kinder Morgan, Inc. (KMI) announced that representatives of KMI intend to participate at the Citi 2026 Natural Resources Conference on August 11-12, 2026, to discuss the business and affairs of KMI. Materials to be used during the event will be available before 8:00 a.m. Central Time on August 10, 2026, on KMI’s website at: https://ir.kindermorgan.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx.
